# CRM Core Workflows & Use Cases

| Workflow | Operational requirement | Relevant capability pattern |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prospect discovery | Build a qualified account pool without losing source context | AI-assisted prospect discovery, source recording and lead synchronisation |
| Outreach and engagement | Personalise communication while respecting regional marketing rules | AI-assisted email preparation, consent/lawful-basis fields, frequency controls and unsubscribe handling |
| Follow-up capture | Reduce the gap between real sales activity and CRM records | Interaction extraction, automatic activity logging and next-action suggestions |
| Opportunity governance | Track stage, value, risk and ownership consistently | Configurable stages, alerts, collaboration, forecast and audit history |
| Quotation and order | Preserve price versions and connect sales commitments to fulfilment | Template quotation, approval rules, product data, order and collection linkage |
| Revenue analysis | Provide management with a reliable operating view | Dashboards, reports, targets, pipeline analysis and forecast review |
